member: Theo — Autonomy and Remote Operations Engineer
message:
Mara, Priya and Sam, eyes-closed driving uses low stow with high eye. Folding perception mast lays flat for start box and stands to see over drum and hopper, carrying First Person View (FPV) meaning live video from robot plus depth and antenna, as shown in stowed versus deployed sketch (E22).

Live video delay stays near blink, since geekbuying.com — DJI RoboMaster S1 4WD FPV RC Robot Intelligent Scratch Python Coding (E13) and robot-advance.com — Robomaster S1 DJI: DJI programmable educational robot (E14) report 80 to 100 millisecond WiFi FPV latency, like fast blink.

Sensing and thinking share stays small. Onboard compute plus cameras plus depth plus Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) meaning motion orientation sensor draw about 29 watt in power sum (E20), like small bulb, and weigh about 1.73 kilogram in mass sum (E21), like bag of sugar. Compute bound matches technical.city — Jetson Orin Nano 4 GB (E16) at 10 watt and kamami.pl — NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano 4GB - ARM Cortex-A78AE processor module + 4GB RAM (E17) and makerselectronics.com — NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Developer Kit 8GB (E18) at 7 to 25 watt, so allowance is ordinary electronics scale.

Loss of signal means stop not runaway. With heartbeat plus Emergency Stop (E-stop) meaning latching stop control, stopping travel (E19) is 0.25 metre at 0.5 metre per second with 0.5 second latency, about one shoe, so hold-to-run holds. I am not ready, because mass-energy and dump tip proofs owned by others stay open.
